description: Demo-day reference manifest mapping verified SHA-256 image hashes to explicit clinical reference categories for live presentation. These reference annotations are for demo visual presentation and are strictly distinguished from genuine AI model predictions.
banner_text: DEMO REFERENCE RESULT — PREDEFINED LABEL — NOT AN AI PREDICTION

85a7e9246dd79ebb05e941269ea377bcf7dd1205.anatomical_suitability: Bulbar conjunctiva clearly visible with prominent circumcorneal/ciliary injection and erythema.
85a7e9246dd79ebb05e941269ea377bcf7dd1205.ground_truth_status: Visual presentation reference control. No microbiological culture or laboratory swab available.
85a7e9246dd79ebb05e941269ea377bcf7dd1205.presentation_notes: Demonstrates conjunctival vascular dilatation typical of acute conjunctivitis. Slit-lamp gating and model inference run in parallel.

617c9b83cebe02f33ae4082e42d7d5ac0d8a8c9e.reference_finding: Suspected Stye / External Hordeolum (Eyelid Margin Lesion)
617c9b83cebe02f33ae4082e42d7d5ac0d8a8c9e.anatomical_suitability: Upper/lower eyelid margin focused with focal erythematous nodular swelling at eyelash base.
617c9b83cebe02f33ae4082e42d7d5ac0d8a8c9e.ground_truth_status: Visual presentation reference control. No clinical histopathology or bacterial culture available.
617c9b83cebe02f33ae4082e42d7d5ac0d8a8c9e.presentation_notes: Demonstrates acute focal inflammatory nodule of the eyelid margin. Research-only checkpoint runs alongside.

d1bc77b75616c58774577909357fe1b7675382a2.reference_finding: Normal Anterior Segment / No Acute Pathology
d1bc77b75616c58774577909357fe1b7675382a2.anatomical_suitability: Full open eye showing clear cornea, white sclera, uninflamed eyelid margin, and no acute conjunctival injection.
d1bc77b75616c58774577909357fe1b7675382a2.ground_truth_status: Visual presentation normal control. Verified clinically healthy appearance across anterior ocular segments.
d1bc77b75616c58774577909357fe1b7675382a2.presentation_notes: Serves as negative control across all disease detectors (conjunctivitis, jaundice, stye, cataract, and non-anemic baseline).

16dd6993995ef8484d04f938d08d9e5febc82a83.intended_category: Everted Palpebral Conjunctiva / Anemia Screening Reference
16dd6993995ef8484d04f938d08d9e5febc82a83.anatomical_suitability: Manually everted inferior palpebral conjunctiva clearly exposed for microvascular pallor inspection.
16dd6993995ef8484d04f938d08d9e5febc82a83.ground_truth_status: Visual inspection reference control. No paired invasive CBC / spectrophotometric blood hemoglobin assay available. Numerical Hb must not be fabricated.
16dd6993995ef8484d04f938d08d9e5febc82a83.presentation_notes: Standard clinical presentation view for conjunctival pallor screening. ResNet-50 regression model evaluates chromatic distribution.
